'''Paul Todd Feldman Feldman's Harvest''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on his fan site [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="harvest">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/Erik.html Feldman's Harvest Deck: Regional Qualifier/DecipherCon Team Winning Deck], Paul Todd Feldman, Torch Industries. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011105084834/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/Erik.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Event:''' [[DecipherCon 1999 Team Event]]
* '''Finish:''' 1st (team)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut|Premiere-L-tatooineobiwanshut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Harvest
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Harvest Feldman LS DecipherCon 1999 Team.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
Feldman wrote that a version of this deck won him a Regional and the team event at DecipherCon. It starts with [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut|Obi-Wan's Hut]] and [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm|Lars' Moisture Farm]]; he listed Hunt Down as its weakness.

Feldman paired this Light deck with his [[DecipherCon 1999 Team Event Paul Todd Feldman DS|Drazin deck]] at the same team event. The newest cards in it are from [[Special Edition]] (November 1998), within the [[Premiere - Endor]] pool of [[DecipherCon 1999]]. The list totals 59 cards as published.
